item.title: Acme Robotics Signs $20 Million Supply Agreement with Walmart
item.description: NEW YORK, Sept. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Acme Robotics, Inc. ("Acme") (NASDAQ: ACMR), a maker of warehouse robots, today announced that it has signed a definitive three-year supply agreement with Walmart Inc. valued at $20 million.

item.title: Bravo Bio Announces Pricing of $5 Million Registered Direct Offering
item.description: Bravo Bio, Inc. (Nasdaq: BRVO) today announced the pricing of a registered direct offering of 2,500,000 shares at $2.00 per share for gross proceeds of $5 million.
